intro: Sarilus Foulborne's Head is a gruesome trophy claimed from an undead sorcerer who defiled the waters of northern Kalimdor. Carried back across the border from the Barrens into Ashenvale, it serves as undeniable proof that the meddling mage has met his end at the hands of the Sentinels.
